scripts.dev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(require('fs').existsSync('frontend') ? 'cd frontend && npm run dev' : 'vite', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(require('fs').existsSync('frontend') ? 'cd frontend && npm install && npm run build' : 'vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.lint: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(require('fs').existsSync('frontend') ? 'cd frontend && npm run lint' : 'eslint .', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
